pull.title: Revert "sql: treat descriptor validation errors as permanent schema change errors"
pull.body:
This reverts commit 3f6c1e2a9b8d7c6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e.

During upgrades, descriptors can fail validation transiently while the cluster version gate is being crossed, so treating validation errors as permanent failed jobs that would have succeeded on retry.

Fixes #101400

Release note (bug fix): Schema change jobs no longer fail permanently on transient descriptor validation errors during upgrades.

commit.message:

reviews.body: Agreed, let's revert until we can tell transient validation failures apart from real corruption.
